videos.title: Waiting 10 Years Could Cost You $789K
videos.description: Invest the 2026 IRA limit of $7,500 a year until 65 at a hypothetical 7%: starting at 25 grows to about $1.5M, starting at 35 to about $708K. That is about $789K less for just $75K less invested. Limits and returns vary. Educational only, not financial advice. #ira #personalfinance #shorts

videos.title: Facebook Rejected Him, Then Bought His App
videos.description: In 2009 Brian Acton was turned down for jobs at Twitter and Facebook, then joined Jan Koum to build WhatsApp. In 2014 Facebook agreed to buy WhatsApp for about $19 billion. #whatsapp #entrepreneur #shorts
